title: Exact complete-return-word precision

theorem.statement: For every realized finite return-gap word of total block span B and every target width k>=4B+5, the conditioned final return-coordinate map modulo 2^k requires exactly k+2B source-coordinate bits.
theorem.upper_bound: The B-block radius-2 causal cone determines k final coordinate bits from k+2B source bits.
theorem.lower_witness: For the least cylinder representative c<2^(2B), the pair c and c+2^(k+2B-1) realizes the same complete return word and its final coordinates differ modulo 2^k exactly in bit k-1.
theorem.consequence: Conditioning on the complete finite return word does not reduce the eventual exact precision loss of two source bits per fringe block.

scientific_boundary: This theorem applies to every finite realized return word. It does not determine the unique infinite zero-initialized orbit, prove permanent avoidance of consecutive gap-two cylinders, prove phase-witness complexity divergence, exclude eventual center period two, or solve Rule 30 center nonperiodicity.
